summary: Iteration-5 targeted retest of the 3 fixes from iteration_4. Backend: all 3 fixes verified. Added TestResumeRetentionAcrossApply (apply with resume A → upload B via account → old resumeId still downloadable by employer) — PASS. GET /api/v1/employer/reports/:id now returns resumeId (reportService.getForEmployer re-populates resumeId from profile) — verified by existing TestReportContact and manual UI reopen. 78 passed, 3 skipped (expected skips for already-applied scenarios). Frontend: /employee/settings now contains the My resume panel (resume-panel / resume-current / resume-download / resume-upload-btn / resume-upload-input / resume-delete / resume-empty flow all functional for priya; replace + delete + re-upload exercised). Found ONE NEW frontend regression: ReportView in /app/frontend/src/pages/employer/Core.jsx used <Download/> icon without importing it from lucide-react, so every time an employer re-opened a historical report via /employer/verify 'Open report', the ReportView component crashed with 'Download is not defined' and the page rendered blank — meaning the fix #1 (getForEmployer returning resumeId) was functionally unusable from the UI. Fixed by adding Download to the lucide-react import. After fix, re-opening a Priya report from the Reports table shows report-contact=priya@demo.in · +91 98200 11223 · Bengaluru and report-download-resume button. Candidate retention fix verified both via backend test and employer download test.

action_items: No further action needed. The ReportView import fix (Core.jsx line 2) is applied and verified. Please review the one-line change.
Consider adding an <ErrorBoundary> around ReportView and other dynamic report components so a missing import or malformed snapshot doesn't produce a silent blank page in future.
critical_code_review_comments: frontend/src/pages/employer/Core.jsx ReportView previously used an undeclared JSX identifier (Download). A lightweight ESLint rule (react/jsx-no-undef is already in default config) should have caught this at build time — build/lint output may be ignored.
No <ErrorBoundary> wrapping ReportView; crashes bubble to the whole route and the user sees a blank screen with no toast.

resumeService.setCurrent correctly checks `Application.exists({ resumeId })` before deleting old resume; however it still clears resumeUrl unconditionally — fine today, but if resumeUrl ever stores an S3 object key, retention logic must apply there too.

reportService.getForEmployer fetch of EmployeeProfile.findById(...).select('resumeId').lean() runs on every GET — negligible, but could be bundled into the initial VerificationCheck query via $lookup or by storing resumeIdSnapshot on the check doc at creation time to make reports fully self-contained.

rca of the issue: ReportView bug RCA: iteration-4 added `report.resumeId ? <Button ...><Download/>Download resume</Button> : <span data-testid='report-no-resume'>` in pages/employer/Core.jsx without importing the Download icon used inside the Button. Because the condition `report.resumeId` was falsy before the backend fix, the Download JSX never rendered and the ReferenceError stayed latent. After the backend fix in reportService.getForEmployer, resumeId is now truthy for reports whose candidate has a resume, which triggers the Download render path and raises 'Download is not defined' — crashing ReportView and showing a blank screen. Reproduction: login hr@acmetech.in → /employer/verify → click 'Open report' on any Priya row → entire panel disappears, console shows PAGEERROR 'Download is not defined' and a React warning about ReportView. Mitigation (applied): `import { ..., Download } from 'lucide-react'` at the top of pages/employer/Core.jsx. Confirmed working: after fix, re-opening a report renders Priya's identity, contact line (priya@demo.in · +91 98200 11223 · Bengaluru), score gauge, employment table AND the Download resume button.
